cases.question: ¿Cuántas unidades recibidas hubo por producto en órdenes de compra de enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(poi.quantity_received) AS unidades FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN product p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND po.issued_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.id AS producto_id, p.name AS producto_nombre, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity_received), 0) AS unidades_recibidas FROM public.purchase_order AS po JOIN public.purchase_order_item AS poi ON poi.purchase_order_id = po.id JOIN public.product AS p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.issued_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.issued_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué facturas de compra activas tienen saldo pendiente en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.series AS series, pi.number AS number, pi.total_amount AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) AS paid_amount, (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0)) AS pending_amount FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi LEFT JOIN public.purchase_payment AS pp ON pp.purchase_invoice_id = pi.id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at <= CAST('2026-01-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING pi.total_amount > COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de ingresos registrados en caja en enero de 2026?

cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(cs.id) AS sesiones_cerradas FROM public.cash_register AS cr JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50

cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_cash), 0) AS total_efectivo, COALESCE(SUM(cs.sales_other), 0) AS total_otros FROM public.cash_session AS cs WHERE DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cs.opened_at) = CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50
